status: pre_enrollment_design; final method, exact test set and benchmark are NOT frozen
hypothesis: MetaG provides experimentally useful estimates of metabolic reaction Gibbs energies for transformations poorly represented in experimental thermodynamic training datasets. No superiority is assumed.
prerequisites: Physically justify and validate the global species-reference policy; consistency checks alone do not establish accuracy.
Declare supported molecular-state pools and assess losses from the current experimental full-molecule profile.
Complete primary-source curation and independent exposure audit for every enrolled equation.

Freeze estimator source/settings/checkpoint/producer, comparator versions/training tables, exact inputs/labels, novelty strata, exclusions, cluster assignments, time/resource budget and ablation arms before evaluating target errors.

eligibility.primary_observation: Experimentally determined dimensionless thermodynamic equilibrium constant with activity/standard-state convention, or evaluated Gibbs energy with an auditable experimental derivation. Rate-law fit parameters, unspecified apparent ratios and concentration-unit constants need explicit derivation and are not automatically admitted.
eligibility.condition_transfer: Use source-owned parameters and propagate reference/bridge uncertainty. Temperature transfer requires thermochemical information; retaining native-temperature measurements is not normalization. Missing ionic strength/free Mg is not imputed for the primary analysis. Unresolved transfers remain secondary or excluded with reasons.
eligibility.identity: Resolve stereochemistry, proton and water conventions, chemical-state families, reaction orientation and primitive stoichiometric extent. Pool identity must be shared by all uses of a metabolite.
eligibility.independence: Exclude measurements used in MetaG development or component calibration and exact/derived duplicate measurements in comparator training; record source ancestry. Different publication or database ID alone does not establish independence.
eligibility.enrollment: Enroll complete eligible source tables/families from the documented inventory. Publish every screened candidate and reason. No selection by experimental magnitude, prediction, disagreement or residual.
eligibility.reference_replication: Do not count repeated conditions or duplicate database rows as independent reactions. Declare one reference construction per equation; carry source uncertainty and conflicts.

novelty.training_identity: Audit the exact comparator checkpoint and training snapshot, parsing failures and unknown rows. Match exact/reverse/scaled equations, full molecular identities and declared protonation/tautomer families. Unresolved identity cannot certify novelty.
novelty.primary_unfamiliar_definition: At least one noncurrency compound family is absent from the audited experimental training corpus AND the greatest nearest-neighbour similarity for that absent compound is below 0.5. Currency set is limited to H2O and explicit H+ for this definition.
novelty.fingerprint: Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, chirality enabled; freeze RDKit version and standardization implementation before enrollment. Similarity is Tanimoto. The 0.5 threshold is a declared operational rule, not a physical extrapolation boundary.
secondary_dimensions: Reaction absent with all compounds present
Transformation-family absence under a fixed, reviewed reacting-center annotation
Scaffold absence where a nonempty scaffold exists; acyclic empty scaffolds are unclassifiable
novelty.UMA_exposure: Report verified overlap when a usable training index exists; otherwise estimated chemistry similarity and unknown exact overlap. Absence from dGbyG labels is not absence from UMA pretraining.
novelty.scored_structures: Audit both original and actually scored structures; no novel-input claim may rely on a reduction to familiar fragments.

methods: Pinned dGbyG model with verified training exclusion or an explicitly specified held-out retraining protocol
Pinned eQuilibrator/component-contribution implementation with training-overlap audit
comparators.comparison: Identical chemical equations, extents and target conditions. Report each method denominator and every pairwise intersection separately; unavailable comparator outputs never become zero.
comparators.uncertainty_baseline: Use the pinned dGbyG ensemble uncertainty definition and raw ensemble outputs. Missing uncertainty makes the incremental reliability question unresolved.

primary_success.scope: Experimental usefulness on the predeclared unfamiliar-chemistry cohort; the numerical thresholds are prospective engineering targets, not universal thermodynamic standards.
primary_success.error: Upper endpoint of the 95% clustered interval for conditional MAE <=10 kJ/mol on all admitted targets with an estimate.
primary_success.coverage: Lower endpoint of the 95% clustered interval for coverage >=0.75 on ALL reference-eligible requests.
primary_success.joint_rule: Both conditions must hold. An empty or inadequately supported unfamiliar cohort is inconclusive. Unsupported molecules, quality refusals and timeouts remain in the coverage denominator.
primary_success.superiority: Not a primary requirement; any lower-error claim uses the paired absolute-error difference and its predeclared uncertainty interval.

statistics.unit: Unique chemical equation at primitive extent; retain repeated-measurement/source ancestry.
statistics.dependence: Before outcomes, assign source/family dependence clusters conservatively as connected components of shared experimental sources or predeclared transformation families. Report sensitivity to source-only and family-only grouping.
statistics.interval: 10000 cluster bootstrap replicates with a recorded random seed, percentile 95% intervals. Recalculate paired differences within the same resampled clusters.
statistics.precision: Use development-only dispersion to justify the enrolled size before scoring. Fewer than 10 independent clusters or an interval too broad to decide the joint success rule yields inconclusive evidence, not a generalization claim. Ten clusters is a minimum gate, not a guarantee of adequate power.
secondary_metrics: coverage by fixed novelty and chemical class
runtime and resource use per requested reaction
statistics.direction: A standard-state sign is not a physiological direction claim. Evaluate direction only under declared activities/concentrations and predeclared near-equilibrium uncertainty rules.
statistics.multiplicity: Treat secondary subgroup and ablation comparisons as exploratory unless separately prespecified with multiplicity handling.

reliability.freeze: Choose diagnostic features, agreement thresholds and prediction/refusal rules using development data only.
reliability.evaluation: Compare retained-error and severe-error risk at identical retained coverage against dGbyG uncertainty alone; report risk-coverage curves and clustered intervals.
reliability.no_assumption: Agreement does not imply independent errors. Shared dissociation information and model/reference bridges must be disclosed.

candidate_arms: Conformer ensemble versus fixed, prespecified single-minimum policy
Solvation-model intervention with the same reference and standard state
Independent-site versus source-owned coupled protonation where physically admitted
Full molecules versus a chemically justified, context-independent approximation with explicit reference accounting
ablations.requirements: Each arm must target the same thermodynamic quantity. Preserve initial outcomes, common-target errors and all arm-specific refusals. No zero filling, outcome-tuned offsets, missing-state renormalization or numerical projection offered as a physical repair.
ablations.interpretation: A change in numerical predictions is sensitivity evidence; improved reference agreement or independently owned component data is required for a physical benefit claim.

coverage_reporting.causal_record: Preserve original input, attempted molecular states, first causal failure, secondary diagnostics and unattempted downstream states.
coverage_reporting.uncertainty: Sampling spread is not a calibrated total prediction interval.

freeze_receipt_required: exact reaction and reference manifests with SHA256
prohibited_interpretation: This design and its candidate inventory do not establish an independent test set, completed physical repair, prediction accuracy or publication readiness.
